highlights: New: collector cards. Shift+click any card in your bag or deck to flip it over and see it as a full card with its own pixel artwork
Every item icon has been repainted, sharper and with shading, and an icon's frame now shows its rarity
New: neckwear for fully grown herzies. Certified Drip, Clam's Finest and Black Tie Optional swing when you spin your herzie
From Oct 20 to Nov 2, seven Halloween items drop for a limited time, including Jack and Boo-tleg, two floating pets, and the Blood Moon. Wear the full Haunted set to bring in the fog
The Herzie view now has Bag and Deck tabs, and your herzie stands on the ground
The app does far less in the background while it's hidden in the tray
Signing in from the app is more secure
Adding a friend shows one line in your activity, with their name
The window no longer reopens on a monitor that's been unplugged
New: Privacy in Settings. Turn off "Share what you're listening to" and friends see that you're listening, but not what, and none of your history. You still earn XP and drops and can join events
Settings now scrolls when it doesn't fit
New: Town. Events are now visitors: Good ol' George, each boss by name, and Orphiez, who has lost a song and needs your help finding it
Coins are now spent with George during his visits. The Store is now Premium
New: the Herzie tab. Your deck sits right over your herzie: click or drag cards to put them on and take them off, and see your stats change before you commit
Cards now upgrade all the way to +10
New: Power Dice 2 (Legendary) takes a card from +3 to +6, and Power Dice 3 (Mythic, a new rarity above Legendary) takes it from +6 to +10
Upgrades from +6 can fail, and a failed roll breaks the card. The upgrade window shows your odds before every roll
New: Safety Pick. Roll with one and a failed upgrade leaves your card as it was
A boss's rewards show from the start of the fight. Click any visitor's "?" to inspect them
You can now have up to 50 friends
Browser audio only counts when it's a real track, so random videos no longer earn XP
New: Events tab. Every live event in one list, with a countdown to the next of each kind
New: Good ol' George. A travelling merchant who drops by now and then with limited stock. Buy before he leaves
New: Bigger Bag in the store. Adds 12 slots to your inventory
New: Stats tab on profiles, so you can see how anyone's herzie is built
Your connection status is now a little heart in the home header
Inventory and deck polish: rarity corners on tiles, no more accidental equips when you drop an item back where it was
New: Power Dice 1. Roll it onto a statted card to raise that card's stats, up to +3 per card
New: Luck stat. It nudges your drops toward rarer items, and the First Edition Card now gives +10 Luck
